Data extraction: Caddyfile directives as KeyValue nodes

```swift title="Swift"
import TreeSitterLanguagePack

let configObj = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.processConfigFromJson("{\"data_extraction\":true,\"language\":\"caddy\"}")
let result = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.process(source: "localhost\nroot * /var/www\nfile_server\n", config: configObj)
debugPrint(result.data() as Any)
debugPrint(result.data()?.kind() as Any)
```
